emma (ml-infra): quick heads-up — running quantized int4 bring-up of Llama3-vocab -> Gemma-compiled model and seeing token collapse / repetitive prefixes at ~step 12 for long contexts. looks like rotary phase got shifted after tokenizer mapping.
raj (research): hmm, token collapse? any diffs vs fp16 baseline logits?
emma (ml-infra): yes, fp16 baseline is fine. int4 quantized binary + new tokenizer map (we ran vocab-consolidate) -> outputs start repeating after ~1k tokens. short contexts ok. suspect rotation mismatch.
sasha (serving): do you have a small repro? can we confirm kv cache token ids are identical between runs?
emma (ml-infra): repro below, tiny script we used to compare cached k/v cos/sin alignment and token ids. PLT shows phase offset shifting by headwise_offset = 2 for some heads.
emma (ml-infra): ```python
# quick check: compute phase diff between fp16 and int4 runs
import numpy as np
fp_sin = np.load('fp16_sin.npy')
int4_sin = np.load('int4_sin.npy')
diff = (fp_sin - int4_sin).mean(axis=(0,1))
print('mean phase diff per head', diff.shape)
# observed values near ~0.03125 increments for heads 3,7,11
```
raj (research): that increment looks suspiciously like token-id/byte-order aliasing. did the tokenizer remap special tokens?
emma (ml-infra): we merged a handful of rare tokens (freq < 5) with their byte-variant entries. mapping table: old_id -> new_id shifted some ranges by +256 where merging occurred.
oliver (ops): could be KV cache indexing using original vocabs; if cache index = token_id % kv_table_size we might see wrap. can you print first 64 kv indices?
sasha (serving): also check rotary sin/cos lookup: our runtime assumes contiguous head dims block (head_dim * head_idx). if tokenmapper changed embedding stride, headwise rotation alignment can drift.
emma (ml-infra): did that check. pasted snippet that corrected phase by offsetting token ids before sin/cos lookup and it mostly fixed short-context but still degrades past 4k.
emma (ml-infra): ```diff
- rot_idx = token_id % rotary_period
+ rot_idx = (token_id + headwise_offset) % rotary_period
```
raj (research): try computing embedding checksum across conversions to ensure no off-by-one in byteorder/embedding dump. also run with model compiled with "preserve_order=True" to see if converter introduced reorder.
oliver (ops): running a quick embed checksum now on the int4 artifact, will post results in ~5m.
ci-bot: CI started: model-evals/rotary-align on commit 1a2b3c — running 3 tests.
oliver (ops): embed checksum diff: l2=0.00012 vs fp16; small but non-zero. also noticed quantizer pads some rows to 32-byte alignment causing stride changes.
sasha (serving): aha — stride change. runtime expects "embedding rows contiguous per token id". quant export added padding rows which shift the base pointer arithmetic. need to use explicit token-id->row index mapping instead of assuming identity.
emma (ml-infra): thanks — adding explicit mapping in runtime + a fallback that checks header.pad_bytes. quick patch below.
emma (ml-infra): ```c
// before: base = embeddings + token_id * row_stride;
// after: idx = header.token_to_row[token_id]; base = embeddings + idx * row_stride;
```
raj (research): that should fix the phase alignment. once fixed we should add a regression test that compares per-head sin/cos dot products for first 4k tokens between fp16 and quantized.
emma (ml-infra): applied patch to serving runtime branch, ran local smoke: > long-context run to 8k tokens no repetition so far. will enqueue full eval.
ci-bot: CI passed: model-evals/rotary-align (3/3) :white_check_mark:
emma (ml-infra): follow-ups: 1) add a conversion-time check to warn when quantizer adds padding rows; 2) add integration test for token_to_row mapping during conversion; 3) note in onboarding doc about tokenizer merges affecting kv indexing.
raj (research): also add a short note in model-interop README about "expect token_to_row mapping" for edge-case converters.
sasha (serving): great catch. felt like a weird failure mode — good to have a short playbook.
emma (ml-infra): ok closing thread after full eval finishes. will send PR link when ready. :pray:
